question: Which of the following groups of elements were NOT discovered at the Mendeleev's periodic table?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Noble gases__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mendeleev's** **periodic** **table**, elements were arranged on the basis of the fundamental property, atomic mass, and chemical properties.
 
• The **modern periodic table **is given by** Henry Moseley.**
 
• Modern periodic table is divided into **18 group and 7 period **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Alkaline** **earth** **metals**, including elements like calcium, magnesium, and strontium, were part of Mendeleev's original periodic table. These elements were known and positioned in the early versions of Mendeleev's table.
 
• **Noble** **gases** like helium, neon, and argon were not discovered at the time of Mendeleev's periodic table. These elements were discovered later, in the late 19th to early 20th century, after Mendeleev had formulated his periodic table.
 
• **Halogens** such as fluorine, chlorine, bromine, and iodine were known during Mendeleev's time, and they were included in his periodic table.
 
• **Alkali** **metals** like lithium, sodium, and potassium were also present in Mendeleev's periodic table. These elements were known and their properties were considered in the development of the table.
